messages:
Lena (PM): Heads-up: Customer PayrollNow asked for a reserved warmup handoff feature. Their ask: schedule warmup windows, deterministic handoff from reserved pool -> live traffic, and contractual visibility into placement/time-of-day. Can we define scope?
Harper (Eng): We can build scheduler + admission control. Key questions: do we guarantee AZ placement? cross-AZ warm adds complexity and cost.
Diego (SRE): Operational view: we need a handoff protocol: (1) reserve GPUs, (2) health-check warm hosts, (3) mark pool as SLA-ready, (4) route traffic. If routing fails, fallback to degraded mode and credit customer.
Sofia (Product): Recommend separating: UX/API for windows + backend autoscale primitives + contract template. Each is a separate deliverable.
Ethan (Finance): Need billing model options to propose: (a) reserved-hours billed fully, (b) reserved + warmup addon at % of reserve/hour, (c) standby credit model. Which do we pilot?
Priya (CS): PayrollNow wants guaranteed 45m prewarm before each scheduled payroll run, with a 5min placement window tolerance. They also want SLA visibility in the Console showing "warmup progress".
Harper (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```
- schedule {start, end, regions, az_preference}
- prewarm_window = start - lead_time
- admission: honor scheduled headroom, allocate opportunistic capacity only if slack > safety_margin
- handoff_signal: mark route_ready=true after KV cache warm check
```
Diego (SRE): Safety margin: default 20% of scheduled headroom non-evictable. Also need an emergency drain policy: if cluster pressure > threshold, allow voluntary spill with notification + credit.
Lena (PM): Launch criteria proposal (MVP):
- Customer can create scheduled warmup window via API/Console
- Backend honor allocation and set "route_ready" flag before window start
- Console shows warmup progress events and allocation_time metric
- SLA doc + pilot contract language drafted
- Playbook for fallback + credit automation
Sofia (Product): Metrics to ship: warmup_allocation_time, warmup_success_rate, prewarm_cost_delta, p95_latency_during_window. Need wireframes for Console tile.
Ethan (Finance): For pilot set warmup addon = 35% of reserved hourly rate (internal only). We'll present as "standby premium". Finance to propose final numbers after cost sim.
Priya (CS): Pilot asks: PayrollNow will run 4 payroll events in the pilot month. They require email + console notification if warmup fails > 10% of events.
Harper (Eng): Risk list:
- cold KV caches for sessions even after host warm (prefix seeding needed)
- contention when many customers schedule concurrent windows (scheduling collisions)
- AZ packing failures -> increased latency if cross-AZ fallback used
We should simulate these in staging.
Diego (SRE): Ops automation: ops-bot should create an incident if warmup_allocation_time > 10m or warmup_success_rate < 90% over a sliding 3-window period. Also automated credit issuance if SLA missed.
ops-bot: Reminder created: "PayrollNow pilot kickoff: schedule follow-up meeting."
Lena (PM): Product decisions to confirm:
- Opt-in per-reservation? (Yes)
- Cross-AZ placement: configurable but in contract we call out possible latency delta (Yes, opt-in with warning)
- Default lead_time: 30m, customers can request up to 60m for higher premium
Sofia (Product): Customer-facing docs: we must include a clear failure mode matrix: allocation timeout -> fallback model -> credit X% per missed window. Priya, can you draft sample language for PayrollNow?
Priya (CS): Will do. Also ask PayrollNow for expected QPS and traffic pattern; we need sample traces to seed staging traffic.
Harper (Eng): On the caching topic: prefix seeding will be P1 for MVP. MVP will validate host warm + route readiness. If latency degradation >10% in alpha, escalate.
Diego (SRE): Staging test cases: concurrent warmups (10 customers), AZ saturation, simulated placement delay. We'll need a cost/safety knob to throttle scheduling acceptance.
Ethan (Finance): Can we attach a daily report for pilot customers showing warmup hours consumed vs billable? That helps acceptance.
Lena (PM): Owners & next steps:
- Harper: design scheduler + handoff protocol (RFC)  due Wed
- Diego: run staging plan and ops-bot triggers  due Fri
- Ethan: cost simulation + starter pricing (35% pilot)  due Tue
- Priya: draft pilot contract + notification language  due Tue
- Sofia: console mockups + metrics list  due Thu
Priya (CS): Scheduling note: PayrollNow asked for 2-week notice to join pilot, I'll confirm dates today.
Lena (PM): Decision: proceed with a closed alpha limited to 3 customers (PayrollNow + 2 others) and test for 4 payroll cycles. If alpha >90% success and cost deltas acceptable, we graduate to beta.
Harper (Eng): I'll land an RFC and a small prototype for the scheduler; will include a sample YAML for scheduled windows.
Lena (PM): Thanks team  please post RFC link here when ready. :rocket:
